title: AP High Court Quashes BSNL Disciplinary Charges Against Retired Employee as Time-Barred
case_name: Yanda Dharma Rao v. The General Manager, BSNL & Ors.
card_summary: BSNL knew of the alleged irregularity, fake certificates linked to 31 of its members, by April 2018 but issued the charge memo to the employee only in September 2023, after he had retired. Justice Balaji Medamalli quashed the charge memo, holding the action fell outside the four-year limit in Rule 61(4)(2)(b) of the BSNL Conduct, Discipline and Appeal Rules, 2006, and ordered release of his withheld retiral benefits.
card_tip: A public sector employer that sits on known misconduct for years cannot revive disciplinary action against a retired employee once its own conduct rules' limitation period has run.
